description: Ten dark fantasy farm decorations: weapon displays, carved guardians, armor, banner, brazier and runestone. Original Higgsfield paint retained at native resolution.

params.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated buildable farm decoration sprite for Riptide RPG. References are STYLE AND MATERIAL guides only; create the new subject below. Match the same polished hand-painted fantasy game aesthetic, thick clean dark outlines, chunky slightly chibi proportions, crisp readable shapes, detailed painterly wood/metal/stone. Slightly elevated front three-quarter camera with shallow depth; prop stands upright with a level footing. Dark cool medieval palette with readable midtones, charcoal iron, dark slate, muted antique brass, restrained colored accents. Not photorealistic, not a flat icon.
Subject: ONE sturdy freestanding dark oak weapon display rack reinforced with charcoal iron and antique brass bolts. Two broad battle axes, one straight steel greatsword and a halberd stand neatly upright in its slots, with a single round battered iron shield resting against the rack. All weapons visibly supported, coherent simple anatomy of blades and handles. Wide horizontal rack, shallow depth, two chunky feet.
Composition: exactly ONE standalone complete decoration, centered, large in frame with 5% transparent safety padding on every side; do not crop any top, weapon, wing, tail or foot. REAL transparent PNG alpha outside the object and through all open gaps. Paint only the physical object. No floor, no ground patch, no cast shadow, no background color, no gradient, no haze, no vignette, no backdrop glow, no checkerboard pattern, no text, no labels, no watermark. The game adds its own ground contact shadow. Consistent soft upper-left light, detailed silhouette edges, full object opaque except explicitly translucent flame tips.

cleanup.method: Only alpha 1-15 farther than 2 pixels from alpha>=16 becomes transparent; every RGB byte and art-core RGBA preserved; native-resolution lossless crop.
cleanup.edgeReview: Native halberd outline tapers to its complete rounded apex at y=0. Five partially transparent alpha>=16 pixels touch top; max alpha 231. Top row retained exactly, no new clipping.
